text:
I'm sorry about the frustration. The $49 was charged on the 25th, and your cancellation on the 26th came after that. Under our policy, a cancellation on or after the 25th applies to the following month's box, and an already-billed box isn't refunded on cancellation and is still sent. So your cancellation did work and you won't be charged again, but this month's box will ship in the first full week of the month.

I can't offer a refund for this charge under the policy. If you'd like, I can escalate your case to a Support Lead to review it. Would you like me to do that?
